title: Playboy Special Editions Book of Lingerie Lot of 4 + Bonus
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage magazines in good overall condition for their age. Covers show normal storage and handling wear, including light scuffs, edge/corner wear and minor creasing. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. Sold as pictured.

Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy special-edition magazines.

Includes:

* Playboy’s Playmate Review — Sixth Annual, 112-page roundup
* Playboy’s Nudes — “Naughty But Nice” holiday edition
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — May/June 1995, “Spring Pleasures”
* Playboy’s College Girls — “Big on Campus”

All 4 magazines pictured are included and sold together as one lot.

Nice assortment of vintage Playboy collector and special-edition publications, including the May/June 1995 Book of Lingerie, Sixth Annual Playmate Review, College Girls and holiday-themed Playboy’s Nudes.

Great addition to a collection of vintage Playboy publications, glamour photography, men’s magazines or Playboy memorabilia.

These are vintage pre-owned magazines and may have age-related shelf and handling wear. Please use the photos as the primary reference for condition and exactly what is included.

Quantity: 4 magazines

Publisher: Playboy

Format: Magazine / Special Edition

Language: English

Genre: Men’s Interest / Photography / Collectibles

Book of Lingerie Date: May/June 1995

Sale: Lot of 4 + 1
